explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and at every D2 except when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by the common transition. There it hits about 10 on the first such trial right after a rare transition (a1 that led to S2, or a2 that led to S1), then fades to about 7-8 on the next one or two a1-to-S1 trials and settles at 0-3 during long a1-to-S1 runs; after a run of plain a2-to-S2 trials it is usually only about 2-5.
